question: What is the difference between the total surface area and the curved surface area of a hemisphere (in cm²) when the radius is 21 cm? (Takе π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The difference between the **Total Surface Area** (3πr²) and the **Curved Surface Area** (2πr²) of a hemisphere is simply the area of its **circular base** (πr²).

Difference = Area of base = πr²

Difference = (22/7) × 21 × 21 = 22 × 3 × 21

Difference = 66 × 21 = 1386 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the hemisphere (r) = 21 cm

Value of π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of hemisphere = 2πr²

Total Surface Area (TSA) of hemisphere = 3πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c264313be857bd4680172ae15e52e9deadc8854f5b52016a454604302554766.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 21

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 3 × 21 = 2772 cm²

⇒ Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 × (22/7) × 21 × 21

⇒ TSA = 3 × 22 × 3 × 21 = 4158 cm²

⇒ Difference = TSA − CSA

⇒ Difference = 4158 − 2772 = 1386 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

A sphere has only one surface area, which is 4πr². A hemisphere is half of a sphere but adds a flat circular base.

Volume of a Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half the volume of a sphere: V = (2/3)πr³.

Base Area Relationship

The TSA of a hemisphere is always 1.5 times its CSA because 3πr² = 1.5 × (2πr²).</p
